title: Working hours for a client invoice
description: Log time by task, correct the breaks and check the arithmetic before exporting the document.

blocks.text: A contractor logs time by task and project, then looks it over before preparing the invoice. A missed timer stop, a break or the wrong project are corrected before the amount is calculated.

quote.text: I got it a couple years ago to track billable hour for a couple different projects and quickly found it so useful that I upgraded to the paid version

blocks.text: Sessions you can check before invoicing

To begin with, one clear report is needed: task, date, duration and the chosen rate. The person decides which sessions to include; logged time is not automatically declared to be work agreed for payment.

This is a more specific scenario than general productivity statistics. It is worth testing on a real period of work: can every line be explained to the recipient, and can the document be prepared without copying the time into a spreadsheet all over again.
